method: BASELINE. Written straight from the deposited text with the writing-l4-rules skill, from the seat of the individual to whom the law is applied, with the design defaults ruled on 2026-10-18; no REFUSE; checked with the stable l4 of VS Code extension 1.6.98. No pipeline, no coverage table, no independent test pass, no human gate.

scope: From the seat of the taxpayer (employee withheld from, sole trader, founder of a private ancillary fund), for the 7 events of the WA cradle-to-grave lives that cite the Act: s 2 (tax file number), s 8C(2), ss 8WA, 8WB; Schedule 1 ss 12-1, 12-10, 12-35, 12-190, 15-10, 15-15, 15-50, 16-5, 16-20, 16-30, 16-75, 16-95, 16-100, 16-105, 16-155 with 389-20, 18-15; Regulations ss 5 (top rate, 45% + 2%), 26, 38, 56; ss 45-1, 45-15, 45-20, 45-30, 45-50, 45-60, 45-61, 45-70, 45-80, 45-110, 45-115(1)(a), 45-320(1) (the rate, with notional tax and base assessment instalment income as inputs), 45-125, 45-130, 45-132, 45-134, 45-140, 45-155; Part IIA ss 8AAC, 8AAD, 8AAE (general interest charge); Part IVC ss 14ZU, 14ZW(1)(aa), (1BB), (c), (2), 14ZX, 14ZYA, 14ZZ, 14ZZC, 14ZZM, 14ZZN; ss 284-75, 284-85 (formula transcribed), 284-90 items 1-3C, 284-220, 284-225; ss 286-75, 286-80; s 298-20(3); ss 426-105, 426-110, 426-120, 426-125(8). Inputs: the withholding schedule amount (schedules not deposited), the penalty unit (Crimes Act s 4AA, indexed), the base interest rate, notional tax, the ITAA 1936 s 170(1) period. Left out: ITAA 1936 Part VA (TFN issue; the scenarios' 'Part VA' is not in this Act), the PAF Guidelines (not deposited: 5% distribution, responsible person), Subdivs 12-C to 12-J, Divs 13, 14, notional tax and the rate formula, GDP adjustment, amended assessments, private rulings, scheme penalties, Division 280, Division 288, acting trustees, collection and recovery. Added 2026-10-24 (taa-instalments-formulas.l4): Sch 1 s 45-405(2), (3), (9), (10) GDP adjustment; s 45-400(2) quarterly instalment on GDP-adjusted notional tax (an input); ss 45-360(1), 45-230(1), (2) benchmark instalment rate and GIC on a varied rate; ss 280-100, 280-105 shortfall interest charge.
seat: the taxpayer: the employee being withheld from, the sole trader paying instalments, and (in Daniel's life) the founder of a private ancillary fund and director of its trustee company
